newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly down, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly down, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed lower by 0.22 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 546.31 from 547.5 on Friday.
Volume was 6.3 million dinars against 3.4 million dinars.
Chemical firm was down 1.7 dinars to 27.5 dinars. UBCI bank declined by 1.34 dinars to 45.96. Banque du Sud eased 0.78 dinar to 25.32. UTB bank slid 0.65 dinar to 21.08 dinars.
